description: Resume from exp756 (E=192 hard, 16K, 1.2301) and continue training for 8K MORE steps with a half-peak->tail cosine schedule (no warmup). LR scale starts at 0.5 and anneals cosine to 0.1 over 8K steps. Same eff bs=48. Tests whether the wallclock budget exp755 spent on hybrid_smooth (~2h extra vs exp756) is better spent extending exp756's hard training. Loads model + AdamW state + Lion(master+momentum) from exp756 checkpoint.
